scenario: [LINT.1.1]: `Int` is an interval element type, so `r.probe in (r.lo .. r.hi)` over `Int` slots compiles. LINT.9.1, the id, is a tombstone.
rules_ds:
schema Range scope logical:
    lo: Int key
    hi: Int mutable
    probe: Int mutable

rule in_range:
    Range r where r.probe in (r.lo .. r.hi)
->
    log info "in range"
